lines: Asagi
We should be safe here, at least for the moment.
After knocking out the Taimanin that had attacked us, Asagi-san and I (a boar) had moved to a slightly secluded area in the forest.
Asagi
I must say... you fight pretty well for a boar. I'm impressed.
Me
I mean, that's more thanks to being a boar...
I had been able to knock out two or three Taimanin by charging at them with the force of a massive boar.
If I were in my normal body, which was not very good at combat, this definitely would not have been possible.
Me
More importantly, sensei... I mean, Asagi-san, what's going on here!?
Me
Why did I turn into this stupidly huge boar...!?
I asked Asagi-san since she seemed to know something about my situation.
I had called her "Asagi-san" and not "sensei" since she was much younger than the Asagi-sensei I knew.
She looked at least 10 years younger... It was just like with Sakura, the freeloader at my place from another dimension.
Asagi
Let's see... to explain it briefly, you're a "scapegoat." A decoy meant to buy time for the real lucky boar to escape, you could say.
Me
A decoy...?
Asagi
Yes, a decoy. I don't think you know, but there's a dangerous ritual called the "Rite of the Auspicious Beast."
Me
Oh! I know about that. If I remember correctly, you have to slay a divine beast summoned from the Otherworld, right?
And by doing so, you would gain the divine beast's immense luck.
The ceremony was only carried out on January 1st, on New Year's Day.

"It was said that once the day ended, the
auspicious beast would turn inauspicious, bringing great calamity to mankind."
...That was what I had gathered from the old document I had read.
Asagi
Hmm? You sure know a lot for a boar.
Me
I-I mean... it's not like I was born a boar...
Asagi
Haha, sorry, I was just joking. I actually know a little bit about what's going on with you.
Me
H-Huh...?
Asagi-san giggled and proceeded to tell me what she knew.
Asagi
Well, you got the gist of the ceremony, right. Summon a divine beast from the Otherworld, and by slaying it you gain the power of its luck.
Asagi

But the summoned divine beastー
the lucky beast, doesn't want to die either, so it'll try to run away with everything it has.
Asagi
That being said, with how it looks, it stands out far too muchー
Asagi
So apparently it sometimes brings along a "scapegoat" from another dimension as a diversion.
Me
A-And that's me...!?
Asagi
I guess so? Unless you've always been a boar.
Me
Seriously...?
I had nothing to do with it, but had been brought here and turned into a boar.
It was no wonder that this beyond-upsetting and bonkers ceremony was forbidden.
Asagi
Before I knew it, Asagi-san was looking at me curiously.
Me
? What is it, Asagi-san?
Asagi
You're surprisingly calm. Most people would be more shocked or scoff at the idea of "another dimension."
Me
I mean, it's not that it doesn't shock me... But, how should I put it, I've had a lot of experiences that lead me to believe things, or should I say traumatic experiences.
I had come back from another dimension thanks to that weird Octo-Guy just the other day.
And if this was another dimension, then it would also explain why Asagi-san here looked so young.
Asagi
Is that so? But anyway, you don't have to worry.
Asagi
If we slay Kiyomaro, the real lucky beast, you should return to normalー
Asagi
And by using the power of his luck, you should be able to return to the dimension you came from.
Me
Really!?
Asagi
Yes. But for that, your cooperation is necessary. Could you help me?
Me
Of course! I mean, there's no way I'm gonna stay in another dimension in this body!
Other dimensions aside, remaining a boar forever would be too horrible.
Asagi
Then let's begin tracking him right away♪ If anyone, you should be able to sniff out where Kiyomaro's hiding.
